summary: Card Authorization Decision program (CICS + IMS + MQ). Triggered by MQ, it processes incoming authorization request messages (up to 500 per run): for each request it reads the card cross-reference, account and customer, computes the available credit, and decides APPROVE or DECLINE based on whether the transaction amount fits within the available credit (and card/account status/expiry). It stores the pending authorization in the IMS authorization database and sends the decision back on the reply queue. This is the real-time authorization engine.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Connect to MQ and open the request and reply queues. Loop getting authorization request messages (up to the process limit of 500): for each, look up the card/account/customer, make the authorization decision, store the pending authorization in IMS, and send the decision reply. Close the queues and return.
branches: PERFORM UNTIL no-more-messages OR WS-MSG-PROCESSED >= WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT

annotations.note: Processes at most 500 authorization requests per invocation (WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT).

paragraphs.name: GET-AUTH-REQUEST
paragraphs.pseudocode: Get the next authorization request message from the request queue (card number, amount, merchant, etc.); set no-more-messages when the queue is empty.

paragraphs.name: LOOKUP-CARD-ACCT-CUST
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card cross-reference by card number to get the account, then read the account, customer and card records needed for the decision.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: an unknown card or account results in a declined authorization.

paragraphs.name: MAKE-AUTH-DECISION
paragraphs.pseudocode: Compute the available credit = credit limit - (current cycle credit - current cycle debit). Approve the authorization if the requested amount is within the available credit and the card is active and not expired; otherwise decline with the appropriate reason (over-limit, inactive card, expired). Record the approved/declined status and reason code.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE (authorization decision): approve only if the requested amount fits within available credit (limit minus net cycle spend) and the card is active and not expired; otherwise decline with a reason (over-limit / inactive / expired).

paragraphs.name: STORE-PENDING-AUTH
paragraphs.pseudocode: Insert the authorization (summary + detail) into the IMS pending-authorization database so it can be settled or expired later (see the CBPAUP0C purge).

annotations.note: Approved/declined authorizations are persisted to the IMS pending-authorization DB (later purged by CBPAUP0C).

paragraphs.name: SEND-AUTH-REPLY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build the authorization decision reply (approve/decline + reason + available credit) and put it on the reply queue.

paragraphs.name: OPEN-QUEUES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Connect to the queue manager and open the request and reply queues.

paragraphs.name: CLOSE-QUEUES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the queues and disconnect from the queue manager.
